birthday.heading: Birthday reward
birthday.description: Add your birth month and day to receive an annual points gift.
birthday.rule: Earn {{ points }} points once a year. Enter your birthday at least {{ days }} days before the reward date. It is locked after the first save.
birthday.privacy: Only your birth month and day are stored. Your birth year is not collected.
birthday.correction: Birthday can only be entered once. Contact store support if it needs to be corrected.
birthday.error: Could not update your birthday. Please try again.
birthday.login_prompt: Sign in to add your birthday.
